studio.title: Demo Studio
studio.lead: Set up the pretend world, then watch Puppet Master in it. Nothing real is touched.

start.title: What do you want to show?
start.lead: The three things people ask for most. Everything else is in the sections on the left.
start.tourSub: {n} steps in three chapters: ask, make the workspace yours, plan.
start.tourResumeSub: Stopped at step {n} of {total}. Start it over from step one.
start.resetSub: Progress only, the layout, or everything this browser kept.
start.recipesLead: One click sets the world up and starts the moment.

newComputer.title: A brand-new computer
newComputer.sub: Fresh computer, no progress kept, onboarding from the start.

returningNas.title: Back with a Home NAS
returningNas.sub: A returning user whose key already works with the Home NAS.

roughDay.title: A rough first day
roughDay.sub: Wrong NAS password, a flaky network and a GitHub name that is taken.

noAi.title: No AI account yet
noAi.sub: Nothing signed in anywhere, so onboarding offers Free Models.

learn.title: Learn the app
learn.sub: The Guided Tour from its first step.

storyFinish.title: Watch a run finish
storyFinish.sub: The story jumps to Run #47 complete and plays at 2x.

busy.title: A busy afternoon
busy.sub: Agents open things, notices arrive and Usage plays the next hour.

nierTour.title: The tour in NieR Mode
nierTour.sub: NieR Mode on, then the Guided Tour with Pod 042.

onboarding.title: Run onboarding in any situation
onboarding.lead: Pick where the person starts, add any twists, then run it. Twists stack.
onboarding.savedNone: Onboarding has not been run in this browser.
onboarding.savedDone: Onboarding was finished in this browser.
onboarding.screensLead: Jump straight to a screen, in the situation above. Screens that need earlier answers fill them in.

fresh.title: Fresh computer
fresh.sub: Nothing set up yet. The usual first run.

returning.title: Returning user
returning.sub: Projects from before are already here.

lowResource.title: Low-resource computer
lowResource.sub: Effects step down so the window stays smooth.

noKeys.title: No SSH keys here
noKeys.sub: This computer has no key to offer the Home NAS.

keyWorks.title: A key already works
keyWorks.sub: The Home NAS already trusts a key from this computer.

hostChanged.title: Home NAS ID changed
hostChanged.sub: The NAS answers with a different identity than before.

wrongPassword.title: Wrong NAS password first
wrongPassword.sub: The first password is refused; the second works.

keyRefused.title: NAS refuses the key once
keyRefused.sub: Its folder permissions are too open the first time.

selfKeyMissing.title: Hand-added key not there yet
selfKeyMissing.sub: The person says they added the key, but it is missing.

readOnly.title: Read-only NAS folder
readOnly.sub: The projects folder on the NAS cannot be written.

nameTaken.title: GitHub name taken
nameTaken.sub: The online copy's name is already used at creation.

flaky.title: Flaky network
flaky.sub: Making the online copy fails once on the network.

cliMissing.title: Claude not installed
cliMissing.sub: Claude has to be installed before signing in.

signedOut.title: Claude signed out
signedOut.sub: Claude is installed but nobody is signed in.

copiedUnavailable.title: Copied account unavailable
copiedUnavailable.sub: An account copied from another computer cannot be used here.

remoteAi.title: AI on a remote Server
remoteAi.sub: The AI accounts live on the Server, not here.

noAi.title: No AI account anywhere
noAi.sub: Nothing signed in on this computer or the Server.

screens.nas-signin: Sign in to the NAS once
screens.nas-pmpair: Pair with Puppet Master on the NAS
screens.nas-folder: Choose a folder on the NAS
screens.nas-smb: Sign in to the shared folder
screens.name: Name the Project

tour.title: Teach the app, step by step
tour.lead: The tour uses the real app. The Demo Studio steps aside while it runs; the tour has its own Skip.

story.title: The Tastebook story
story.lead: Behind the app runs a pretend project with its own clock. Play it, speed it up, or jump ahead.
story.pointsLead: A jump fills in everything before it. The story only moves forward; start it over to go back.
story.overSub: Reloads the page. Your layout and settings stay.

workspace.title: The Home workspace
workspace.lead: Change the panel layout and watch agents work beside you.
workspace.layoutsLead: Open tabs move into the new shape; nothing closes.
workspace.resetLayoutSub: Panels go back to their default places. Open files, terminals and chats stay.
workspace.standInSub: The scripted chat beside the panels that can open every kind of tab.
workspace.agentsSub: Six agents open a terminal, a browser, a plan, a file, a crew run and a transcript, each behind your work.
workspace.terminalSub: Query Analyzer opens its own terminal in the background and reruns the bench.
workspace.askSub: An agent asks to type into your terminal. You allow it once, for the terminal, or say no.

usage.title: Usage demo readings
usage.lead: The Usage page reads pretend accounts. Pause them, or run the clock an hour ahead.
usage.liveSub: New readings arrive about every six seconds while Usage is open.
usage.hourSub: Two demo minutes pass every tick until an hour has gone by.
usage.backSub: The clock and readings return to the real time.
usage.gallerySub: Every chart in every state, on the current look.

notices.title: Sample notifications
notices.lead: Each one arrives through the title bar's bell exactly as a real one would.

approval.title: Needs your approval
approval.sub: A builder waits on a decision

looks.title: Every look, light and dark
looks.lead: The whole app changes, this Studio included. The choice is saved to the Project like the title bar's.
looks.nierSub: Ink and parchment over Basic, with Pod 042.
looks.reducedSub: Movement becomes fades. The Studio, onboarding and the tour follow it.
looks.soundSub: Clicks and chimes in the look's own voice.

lg.title: Liquid Glass
lg.lead: Glass always uses Liquid Glass. Choose how it is drawn.

walls.title: Wallpaper
walls.lead: Any wallpaper in any look. It shows behind the app in every look, in the print that follows light or dark.

reset.title: Start the demo over
reset.lead: Choose how much goes. Nothing outside this concept is touched.

progress.title: Progress
progress.sub: Onboarding, the Guided Tour and the situation go back to a fresh computer. Then onboarding opens.

layout.title: Workspace layout
layout.sub: The Home panels go back to their default layout. Nothing else changes.

everything.title: Everything
everything.sub: All of the above and everything else this concept saved in this browser, the 5.6 Pro chat demo's data included. Then the page reloads as a first run.

reset.staysLayout: Open tabs, onboarding, the tour and settings.
reset.staysEverything: Nothing kept by this concept. Your real files and accounts were never touched.

items.tour: Guided Tour progress and its saved layout
items.chat56: The assistant chat demo's data (5.6 Pro)
items.studio: Where this Studio was moved to

switches.title: Reload with switches
switches.lead: Review switches live in the page address. Pick them, then reload. They last for that visit.
switches.normalSub: Onboarding opens on a first run.
switches.offSub: Straight to the app (what automated checks use).
switches.freshSub: Onboarding from the start, in Basic Dark.
switches.tourOnSub: The tour begins as the page opens.
switches.pmhSub: Cards and rows without the shared hover.
switches.liveSub: The Usage page opens without new readings.
switches.softSub: Usage draws the way a computer without graphics acceleration sees it.

toast.resetLayout: The Home layout is back to its default.
toast.unavailable: That is not available on this page right now.

studio.moveHint: Drag the title bar, or press the arrow keys here (Shift for bigger steps). Home puts it back in its corner.
studio.putBack: Put the Studio back in its corner
